algorithm: Perform BFS/DFS starting from each unvisited node to find connected components
For each node, if not visited, initiate BFS to explore all reachable nodes
Collect all reachable nodes as a component
Sort the list of components lexicographically
constraints: Edges are distinct and unordered pairs with u < v
Graph is simple (no self-loops or multiple edges)
Output must be JSON-compatible (strings for vertices)
Components must be internally sorted lexicographically
Outer list of components must be lexicographically sorted
edge_cases: n=1 with no edges: single component ["0"]
n=2 with one edge: two components ["0", "1"]
n=3 with two edges: one component ["0", "1", "2"]
All nodes isolated: n components each with one node
inputs: n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs with 0<=u<v<n
output: List of lists of vertex strings, each inner list sorted lexicographically, outer list sorted lexicographically
purpose: Generate connected components for an und:graph with n nodes and edges list
